title: Video Stream & Reel Downloader
summary: Watch & save your favorite videos, and stream your events live to FB
description:
With video downloader & streaming app, you can go live on Facebook to broadcast any virtual event, performance, conversation, Q&A session, or even videos from your gallery. The app also allows you to stream directly to Facebook and download your favorite videos instantly.

Your audience can join your live broadcast in real time and interact through comments, questions, emoji reactions, and shares. This makes your live sessions more engaging and helps you connect better with your community. Viewers can watch your live stream from their phone, computer, or connected TV.

✔ Broadcast events, performances, Q&A, or videos live to FB
✔ Easily watch & save FB videos for offline viewing and share them anytime with friends.
✔ Paste your favorite video's link into the app, and save it for later viewing

You can go live on your Facebook profile, pages, or events. The app offers helpful tools such as multi-posting your live stream to multiple pages and controlling who can access your broadcast with privacy settings.

With video downloader feature, your favorite FB videos are always just a tap away. Simply copy the link from any public FB video—whether it's a viral clip, a memorable live stream replay, a tutorial, or a friend's shareable moment—and paste the URL directly into the app. With one click, you can download the video instantly.

This powerful feature acts as your personal video library, allowing you to watch your saved content anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. Perfect for commuting, traveling, or just saving on data usage. Never let limited connectivity interrupt your viewing experience again.

For creators and viewers alike, this is the ultimate tool for archiving inspiration, saving valuable content for later review, or keeping a collection of your most-loved videos. Enjoy buffer-free playback on your own terms, without ads or distractions, and share them easily with friends and family.

With this video downloader & streaming app, you have the power to not only broadcast live and grow your community but also to capture and keep the content that matters to you. Stream, interact, and build your personal video collection—all from one seamless app.
